_comment: CORRECTNESS REGIME: reference-dtype F32 GGUF; C++ MelFrontend real mel (constant-pad centered STFT, floor(n/hop)+1 frames, trailing frame zeroed and masked as in the HF processor); --backend cpu. Reference: HF Transformers Nemotron3DiarizationForAudioFrameClassification with the processor attention mask.

Nemotron-3 Diarization is an encoder-diarizer: diar.preds_offline is [T, 8] sigmoid activity at the 10 ms mel rate from one full-context forward; diar.probs is the chunked AOSC/FIFO product path at the preset in force (checkpoint offline geometry 340/40/40/300/264 by default).

Measured on sortformer-2spk-mix: mel 1.7e-4, embed 1.9e-4, encoder 2.2e-5, proj 5.4e-5, upsample 7.6e-5, preds/probs 4.2e-6 max_abs. Finalized = 1.5 x observed. Multi-chunk and compression parity: VALIDATE_NEMOTRON3_DIAR_PRESET=small / low_latency / ultra_low_latency all within 6.3e-6 with zero threshold flips.
